verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents multiple one-command install paths (Docker, pip, uv, Kubernetes) and explicitly claims 'zero to your first AI conversation in under five minutes,' matching the story closely; community comments confirm the Docker install works in practice (though grumble about image size and requiring Docker at all). Missing for 10: independent timing benchmarks of the actual install-to-chat experience and a single canonical 'installer script' rather than multiple package-manager options.
